concept_sha256.description: SHA-256 of concept_quote; computed by tooling and cross-checked by the measurer against the value it derives from the quote.

project_dir.description: HAMR project root relative to the experiment directory ('.' when they coincide).

session_metrics.description: Path to session-metrics.json relative to the experiment directory.

hamr_version.description: Toolchain version used by the original run, when discoverable; null otherwise.

generation_baseline.description: Path to a prepared pristine-generation baseline, when one exists; usually supplied at measure time via --generation-baseline instead.
